TablesPage.title: Tables
TablesPage.description: The same users in every table style: plain, striped, condensed, bordered and combined. Rows are shuffled on each visit; wide tables scroll sideways.
TablesPage.bordered_description: Every cell ruled, columns of equal width.
TablesPage.combined_description: Pressed highlight, striped, bordered, condensed and fixed at once.
TablesPage.combined_dark_description: The same table printed on the folder green, which stands in for the dark style.

AdvancedTablesPage.title: Advanced tables
AdvancedTablesPage.description: One data table, four uses: filters and details, a simulated backend, CSV download and row selection.
AdvancedTablesPage.demo_description: Search the whole table or a column, sort by any head, change the rows per page and open a row for details.
AdvancedTablesPage.backend_description: Filters, sorting and paging go to a simulated backend that answers after a second. Filters apply when you leave the field or submit it from the keyboard.
AdvancedTablesPage.download_description: Filter and sort, then share every matching row as a CSV file.
AdvancedTablesPage.download_button: Share {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} (.csv)
AdvancedTablesPage.select_description: Tap a row or its checkbox to select it; the head checkbox selects every filtered row.
